testCases.label: Verify CSS specificity for ID selectors
testCases.description: Uses Selenium WebDriver to compare two elements with different ID-based CSS rules, asserting that the higher-specificity element has the expected color, font size, and font weight, and that the lower-specificity element has its own expected styles.

testCases.label: Verify CSS specificity for class selectors
testCases.description: Uses Selenium WebDriver to validate that elements with different class-based CSS specificity receive the correct color, font size, and font weight based on their applied class selectors.
